title: erigeron canadensis var. glabratus
intro: Erigeron canadensis var. glabratus, commonly known as American fleabane or rough fleabane, is a perennial herb plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its multiple health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron canadensis var. glabratus include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antiseptic and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
